name: Myla Developer API
description:
The Myla Developer API lets you read and manage your Myla data programmatically — contacts, conversations, and outbound webhooks.

## Authentication
All requests require a brand-scoped API key sent as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer myla_sk_xxxxxxxx
```

Create a key in your Myla dashboard under **Settings → Integrations → Developer API**. Each key is scoped to a single brand/workspace.

## Responses
Successful responses wrap the payload in a `data` field. List endpoints also include a `meta` object with `page`, `limit`, and `total`. Errors return an `error` string with the relevant HTTP status code.

## Rate limits
Requests are rate limited per API key. If you exceed the limit you will receive an HTTP 429 response; retry after a short delay.
